annotations.title: Website Tech Stack Checker: CMS, Framework, CDN, Analytics

description: Detect the technologies a public website uses: CMS or site builder, JavaScript framework, CDN and hosting, web server, analytics and tag managers, advertising pixels, support widgets, payments, consent tools. Each result shows its evidence (header, meta tag, script URL or page source) and a confidence level. Reads one page; respects robots.txt. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

url.description: One public http(s) URL or domain. Use this or urls.

urls.description: Up to 20 URLs or domains; each successfully checked site is one billable result.
